name: Chaosflix
description: Browse and stream Chaos Computer Club conference talks from media.ccc.de directly in Jellyfin. Includes watch history, resume, SyncPlay support, popular/recommended talks, year-based browsing, and related talk suggestions.

versions.changelog:
Features:
- show the plugin's state on its configuration page (#93)
Plus 5 other changes.

Features:
- offer every recording as a selectable version (#74)
Bug fixes:
- detect the login route by url, not by #loginPage (#78)
- read a command's arguments without its redirections (#77)
- keep the recently added row to one copy per talk (#73)
- stop releases from a checkout behind the remote (#66)
- and 1 more
Plus 2 other changes.

Bug fixes:
- hand out the item id as the media source id (#63)
- end a proxied stream quietly when the client hangs up (#59)
Plus 5 other changes.

Features:
- infer the next release version from the commits
- generate release notes from the commit history
Bug fixes:
- let the release workflow own the artifact and checksum (#50)
- start the e2e stack from a clean state
- judge -C into a nested worktree by that worktree
- annotate the release tag with the generated notes
- and 13 more
Plus 8 other changes.
